title: Spectrum SW420-Expert 2-in-1 Petrol Lawn Scarifier/Aerator
description: Power and Precision for a Healthier Lawn Achieve a lush, well-maintained lawn with the Spectrum SW420 Expert 2-in-1 Petrol Lawn Scarifier & Aerator. Designed to remove thatch and moss efficiently, this powerful machine enhances grass growth by improving airflow and nutrient absorption. Whether you're a dedicated gardener or a professional landscaper, the SW420 Expert provides the performance and ease of use you need. High-Performance Engine for Maximum Efficiency Powered by a 212cc air-cooled four-stroke OHV engine, this machine delivers 4.5kW of power, ensuring effortless removal of unwanted debris. This level of power is typically found in high-end professional scarifiers, making it ideal for tackling even the most challenging lawn conditions. The OHV engine design promotes quiet operation, fuel efficiency, and reduced emissions, offering both economic and environmental benefits. Dual-Function Design: Scarifying & Aerating With two interchangeable cassettes, the SW420 Expert seamlessly switches between scarifying and aerating modes. Use the scarifying blades to remove surface thatch or swap to the aerator - 13 sets of tines - to enhance root growth, ensuring year-round lawn health. Adjustable Depth for Customized Lawn Care The six-stage depth adjustment lets you fine-tune the machine to match your lawn's specific needs. Opt for a higher setting for light aeration or go deeper for intensive scarification. Adjustments are made effortlessly using the handlebar-mounted lever, ensuring a seamless experience. Convenient Features for Effortless Operation 45-litre debris collector: Keeps your lawn clean, eliminating the need for manual raking. Ball-bearing wheels: Provide smooth movement across all types of terrain with minimal effort. Foldable handlebar & collapsible fabric catcher: Simplifies storage and transportation. Large fuel tank: Reduces the need for frequent refueling, allowing uninterrupted operation. Built for Durability The sturdy steel deck and housing ensure long-lasting performance, even under tough conditions. Built for reliability, this scarifier and aerator is a solid investment for any lawn care routine. Whether you're maintaining a home garden or managing professional landscapes, this machine delivers the power, versatility, and durability needed to keep your lawn in top condition.
